environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing) forwarding all traffic on port 8080 directly to the container. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No CloudFront distribution configured. Task IAM role has basic ECS execution permissions. Container runs with default Fargate platform version 1.4.0 (Linux, no additional seccomp profile). ALB has no WAF WebACL attached.

config.network: public subnet, IGW attached, SG inbound 0.0.0.0/0:8080
config.load_balancer: ALB internet-facing, no WAF, direct passthrough
config.container: Fargate PV 1.4.0, default seccomp, no memory protection flags
config.access_control: none - direct HTTP access to origin
